title: Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori

thread.title: Red River • Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers considered the art and animation notably rough, with some finding the episode’s presentation disappointing enough to stop watching.
Several viewers remain entertained and interested in the story despite its production shortcomings, while others found the writing messy or difficult to take seriously.
Reactions to the central romance were divided: some enjoyed its progression, while others felt it advanced too abruptly and made the relationship dynamics frustrating.
Some commenters enjoyed the episode’s humor, dramatic energy, and deliberately exaggerated feel.
A number of viewers liked the historical details and the protagonist’s growing competence and independence.
